description: Water, Power and Electricity Usage - City of Greater Geelong is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Greater Geelong. Water, Power and Electricity usage for Council owned buildings in the City of Greater Geelong Area. Green house gas emissions and total consumption Kwhs for the last two years can be found. Coverage: City of Greater Geelong. The portal files it under the publisher City of Greater Geelong. Its tags are Asset, ERM, Economy, Economy, Environment. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
